description.en: Read-only Gitea and Forgejo tools over the REST API both projects share: repositories, issue and pull request search, PR diffs and changed files, and Actions runs, jobs and job logs.
description.zh: 面向自建 Gitea / Forgejo 的只读工具，走两者共用的 REST API：仓库列表、议题与 PR 搜索、PR diff 与变更文件，以及 Actions 运行、任务与任务日志。
